# IngrediLens

> IngrediLens is an iPhone and iPad app that reads the ingredient list on food and cosmetic labels and highlights the allergens and ingredients you chose to avoid, including “may contain” warnings. It reads labels in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French and Italian, works without an account, and keeps your data on your device. It is free to download, with an optional Premium subscription.

Key facts: iPhone and iPad (iOS / iPadOS 17+). Free download with 2 filters; optional Premium subscription (monthly with 3-day free trial, yearly with 7-day free trial). No account; data stays on the device; no ads or tracking. Reads labels in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French and Italian; free restaurant allergy card in 15 languages. Built-in database of more than 24,000 ingredients with cited sources (EU Regulations 1169/2011, 1223/2009, 1333/2008, CosIng, US FDA FALCPA/FASTER Act). Not a medical device: it never says a product is safe, cannot detect cross-contact, and users must always read the pack. Developer: Enescan İşler (independent). Current version 1.4 (28 October 2026). Contact: enescanisler@icloud.com

- About / fact page (canonical facts, method, sources): https://ingredilensapp.com/about/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806595642
- Support and FAQ: https://ingredilensapp.com/
- Privacy policy: https://ingredilensapp.com/privacy.html
- Full version of this file: https://ingredilensapp.com/llms-full.txt

## Guides (English)

- [All guides (hub)](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/): food allergy and label guides in English, Español, Português, Deutsch, Français, Italiano
- [How to read allergen labels on food (EU, UK and US)](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/how-to-read-allergen-labels/): In the EU and UK, allergens are part of the ingredients list and must be emphasised, usually in bold.
- [What does "may contain" mean on food labels?](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/may-contain-traces-meaning/): “May contain” and “traces of” warn about possible cross-contact: the allergen is not in the recipe but could get into the product during production.
- [The 14 EU allergens list, explained with examples](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/eu-14-allergens-list/): EU and UK law (Annex II of Regulation 1169/2011) lists 14 allergens that must be emphasised in the ingredients list: cereals containing gluten, crustaceans, eggs, fish, peanuts, soybeans, milk, tree nuts, celery, mustard, sesame, sulphites, lupin and molluscs.
- [The 9 major food allergens in the US (FALCPA and sesame)](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/us-major-food-allergens/): US food labels must declare nine major allergens: milk, egg, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans and sesame, which was added from 1 January 2023 by the FASTER Act.
- [E-numbers explained, what the codes on food labels mean](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/e-numbers-explained/): E-numbers are codes for food additives authorised in the EU, such as E330 for citric acid; the label shows the additive’s function followed by its name or E-number.
- [Hidden gluten on food labels, names to look for](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/hidden-gluten-names/): Gluten is in wheat (including spelt, durum, semolina and khorasan), barley, rye and foods made from them, such as malt, bulgur, couscous and seitan.
- [Hidden milk on labels, other names for dairy](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/hidden-milk-names/): Milk can appear as casein, caseinates, whey, lactose, ghee, butter, cream, curd or milk solids.
- [Hidden egg on food labels, other names for egg](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/hidden-egg-names/): Egg can appear on labels as albumen or albumin, ovalbumin, ovomucoid, lysozyme (E1105), egg lecithin or dried egg.
- [Hidden soy on food labels, other names for soya](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/hidden-soy-names/): Soy can appear as soya, soy lecithin (E322), edamame, miso, tempeh, tofu, textured vegetable protein (TVP) or hydrolysed soy protein, and on cosmetics as Glycine Soja.
- [Hidden peanut and tree nut names on food labels](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/hidden-peanut-tree-nut-names/): Peanuts are legumes and tree nuts are a separate allergen group, so labels and allergists treat them separately.
- [Sesame, mustard, celery and lupin, the overlooked allergens](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/sesame-mustard-celery-lupin/): Sesame, mustard, celery and lupin are on the EU’s list of 14 allergens and often hide in tahini, spice mixes, stock cubes, sauces and gluten-free flours.
- [Travelling with food allergies, restaurant allergy cards](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/restaurant-allergy-card-travel/): Before a trip with a food allergy, update your plan with your doctor, pack your adrenaline auto-injectors and learn the local words for your allergens and “may contain”.
- [Eating out with coeliac disease, a practical guide](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/eating-out-coeliac-disease/): With coeliac disease even small amounts of gluten matter, so eating out depends on how the kitchen avoids cross-contamination.
- [Food allergies at school and childcare, what to give carers](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/food-allergy-school-plan/): Give the school, nursery or carer an allergy action plan completed with your child’s doctor, in-date adrenaline auto-injectors if prescribed, and a clear list of the foods to avoid with their other names.
- [Reading cosmetic INCI ingredient lists for sensitive skin](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/cosmetic-ingredients-sensitive-skin/): Cosmetic ingredients are listed by INCI name in descending order of amount, with ingredients under 1% in any order at the end.
- [How to choose an allergen scanner app, a checklist](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/allergen-scanner-app-checklist/): Allergen scanner apps either look up a barcode in a database or read the ingredient list printed on the pack.
- [How to keep a food reaction diary to find triggers](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/food-reaction-diary/): A reaction diary records what you ate or used, when symptoms started, what they were and how bad they were, plus foods you tolerated.
- [Allergy and ingredient scanner apps compared](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/allergy-scanner-apps-compared/): Scanner apps fall into four groups: barcode scorers (such as Yuka), diet and allergy filters (such as Fig), cosmetic ingredient apps (such as INCI Beauty and Think Dirty) and label readers (such as IngrediLens).
- [IngrediLens: questions and answers](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/ingredilens-faq/): IngrediLens reads food and cosmetic ingredient lists with the iPhone camera, a photo, typed text or a barcode, and highlights the allergens you choose plus "may contain" statements.
- [Yuka alternative for food allergies: what to use](https://ingredilensapp.com/guides/en/yuka-alternative-food-allergies/): Yuka rates the overall health impact of food and cosmetics, which is useful for healthier shopping.

- [Free restaurant allergy card (15 languages)](https://ingredilensapp.com/allergy-card/): Make, print or save a card that explains your food allergies to restaurant staff abroad.
- [Ingredient list allergen checker](https://ingredilensapp.com/ingredient-checker/): Paste an ingredient list and see which of your allergens and “may contain” warnings it mentions.

# Pawfood

> Pawfood is an iPhone app that scans dog and cat food labels and checks the ingredients against your pet's allergies and avoid list. It reads a barcode or a photo of the ingredient list (also on iPad) and matches every ingredient against the allergens, suspected sensitivities and avoid items the owner records for each pet. It explains vague terms such as "poultry" or "animal fat", compares foods on a dry matter basis and keeps a food journal. Privacy: pets, scans and journal stay on the device; no account, no ads, no tracking; buying or restoring Pawfood Plus sends an anonymous purchase record (random ID, no personal or pet data) to RevenueCat.

Key facts: iOS / iPadOS app, App Store https://apps.apple.com/app/id6831189714. Languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, French. Free download with 3 scans; result status and allergen matches are always shown and brand recall notices are always free; optional Pawfood Plus subscription (Premium or Family, monthly or yearly, yearly with a 3-day free trial) adds unlimited scans, full ingredient breakdown with dry matter and carbohydrate estimates, comparison of up to 4 foods, food journal with vet report PDF. Four result states: "Match found", "Worth a closer look", "No recorded match" (never a safety statement), "Not enough data". Knowledge base: 767 ingredients, 76 allergen families, 14 species notes, editorial draft not reviewed by a veterinarian, sourced from AAFCO, FEDIAF, EU feed law, U.S. FDA, WSAVA, Merck Veterinary Manual and peer-reviewed papers. Not a veterinary service: no diagnosis or treatment. Product data: Open Pet Food Facts (ODbL); recall data: openFDA. Publisher: Opsis Digital, support@opsisdigital.com.

- Home page: https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ (also https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/, https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/, https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/, https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/, https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/)
- Ingredient explanations (EN): https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/ · (TR): https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/ingredients/
- Dry matter calculator: https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tools/dry-matter-calculator/ · (TR): https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/tools/dry-matter-calculator/
- Guides: https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/ · Allergen families: https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/allergies/ · Questions and answers: https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/
- Privacy policy: https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/privacy.html · Terms: https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/terms.html

## Pawfood guides (English)

- [Food allergy or food intolerance? How they differ in dogs and cats](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/allergy-vs-intolerance/): Food allergy involves the immune system; intolerance doesn't. Signs overlap, so only a vet-led elimination trial can tell them apart. What to know and note.
- [\"Poultry\", \"animal fat\", \"natural flavor\": vague pet food label terms explained](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/ambiguous-terms-poultry/): Which pet food label terms don't name the animal, what each one can contain, why it matters for allergy lists, and how to get a straight answer from the manufacturer.
- [What "by-product" and "meal" really mean on a pet food label](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/by-products-and-meals/): By-products and meals are defined feed terms, not insults. Learn what they include, why the species name matters and how to read them for allergies.
- [Most commonly reported food allergens in cats, and where they hide on labels](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/common-cat-food-allergens/): Beef, fish and chicken top the published cat cases. What the numbers mean, why they aren't a risk ranking, and where those proteins hide on cat food labels.
- [Dry matter basis explained: how to compare wet and dry pet food](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/dry-matter-basis/): What dry matter is, how to convert a guaranteed analysis step by step, how to estimate carbohydrates honestly, and the mistakes that make comparisons misleading.
- [Keeping a pet food journal: what to record and how to share it with your vet](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/food-journal-guide/): A practical guide to logging foods, treats, symptoms, stool and weight in a way your vet can use, without reading too much into the patterns yourself.
- [Grain-free pet food: what the label means and what it doesn't](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/grain-free-explained/): Grain-free means no cereal grains; it isn't a low-carb or allergy claim. What replaces grains, and what the FDA said about diet and DCM.
- [How to read a dog or cat food label, step by step](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/how-to-read-pet-food-labels/): A practical walk through every part of a pet food label: product name rules, ingredient order, guaranteed analysis, the adequacy statement, feeding guide and the small print.
- [Hydrolyzed protein diets: how they work and what the label tells you](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/hydrolyzed-protein-diets/): Hydrolysis breaks proteins into small pieces the immune system is less likely to recognize. Less likely is not never: what studies found, what to ask.
- [Preservatives in pet food: mixed tocopherols, BHA, BHT and ethoxyquin](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/preservatives-explained/): A neutral look at why pet foods contain preservatives, how natural and synthetic antioxidants differ, what the rules say and how to read them on a label.
- [Puppy and kitten food labels: growth, all life stages and large breeds](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/puppy-kitten-food-labels/): What to check on a puppy or kitten food label, from the growth statement and the large-breed wording to calories, calcium and feeding guides.
- [Senior pet food labels: what "senior" does and doesn't tell you](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/senior-pet-food-labels/): There is no separate legal standard for senior pet food. Learn what to check on the label instead, from calories and protein to joint claims and missing values.
- [How treats and toppers can undo an allergy diet](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/treats-and-toppers/): Treats, chews, toppers and flavoured extras often carry the very proteins a diet avoids. Here is how to check them and keep a diet trial consistent.
- [Wet vs dry pet food: how to compare the labels fairly](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/guides/wet-vs-dry-food-labels/): Wet food looks low in protein because it is mostly water. Learn to compare canned and dry labels on a dry matter and calorie basis, step by step.

## Pawfood guides (Türkçe)

- [Mama alerjisi mi, intolerans mı? Kedi ve köpeklerde fark](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/allergy-vs-intolerance/): Mama alerjisinde bağışıklık sistemi devrededir, intoleransta değil. Belirtiler benzediği için ayrımı veteriner kontrolünde eliminasyon denemesi yapar.
- [\"Kanatlı\", \"hayvansal yağ\", \"doğal aroma\": mama etiketindeki belirsiz terimler](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/belirsiz-terimler-kanatli-hayvansal-yag/): Hangi mama etiketi terimleri hayvanın adını vermez, her biri neyi içerebilir, alerji listeleri için neden önemlidir ve üreticiden net yanıt nasıl alınır.
- [Mama etiketinde "yan ürün" ve "un" gerçekte ne anlama gelir](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/by-products-and-meals/): Yan ürün ve un tanımlı yem terimleridir, hakaret değil. Neleri kapsadıklarını, hayvan adının neden önemli olduğunu ve alerji açısından nasıl okunacağını öğren.
- [Kedilerde en sık bildirilen mama alerjenleri ve etikette nerede saklandıkları](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/common-cat-food-allergens/): Yayımlanmış kedi vakalarında sığır eti, balık ve tavuk başı çekiyor. Rakamlar ne anlatır, neden risk sıralaması değildir, bu proteinler etikette nerede gizlenir?
- [Kuru madde nedir, nasıl hesaplanır: yaş ve kuru mamayı karşılaştırmak](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/kuru-madde-nedir-nasil-hesaplanir/): Kuru maddenin ne olduğu, analitik bileşenlerin adım adım nasıl çevrileceği, karbonhidratın dürüstçe nasıl tahmin edileceği ve karşılaştırmayı yanıltan hatalar.
- [Mama günlüğü tutmak: ne kaydetmeli, veterinerle nasıl paylaşmalı](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/food-journal-guide/): Mamayı, ödülleri, belirtileri, dışkıyı ve kiloyu veterinerinin kullanabileceği şekilde kaydetmek için pratik bir rehber; örüntüleri tek başına yorumlamadan.
- [Tahılsız mama: etiket ne söyler, ne söylemez](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/grain-free-explained/): Tahılsız, mamada tahıl olmadığını söyler; düşük karbonhidrat ya da alerji iddiası değildir. Yerine ne konur ve FDA'nın DCM incelemesi neler söyledi?
- [Kedi ve köpek maması etiketi adım adım nasıl okunur](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/mama-etiketi-nasil-okunur/): Mama etiketinin her bölümünü pratik olarak anlatır: ürün adı kuralları, içerik sırası, analitik bileşenler, yeterlilik beyanı, besleme önerisi ve küçük yazılar.
- [Hidrolize protein diyetleri: nasıl çalışır, etiket ne söyler?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/hydrolyzed-protein-diets/): Hidroliz proteini küçük parçalara ayırır; bağışıklık sisteminin onu tanıma ihtimali azalır ama sıfırlanmaz. Çalışmalar ne buldu, veterinerine ne sormalısın?
- [Mamalarda koruyucular: karışık tokoferoller, BHA, BHT ve etoksikin](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/preservatives-explained/): Mamalarda neden koruyucu bulunduğuna, doğal ve sentetik antioksidanların farkına, kuralların ne dediğine ve etikette nasıl okunacağına tarafsız bir bakış.
- [Yavru köpek ve yavru kedi maması etiketi: büyüme, tüm yaşam evreleri ve büyük ırklar](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/puppy-kitten-food-labels/): Yavru köpek ya da yavru kedi maması etiketinde nelere bakmalı: büyüme beyanı, büyük ırk ifadesi, kalori, kalsiyum ve besleme önerisi.
- [Yaşlı hayvan maması etiketi: "yaşlı" ne söyler, ne söylemez](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/senior-pet-food-labels/): Yaşlı hayvan maması için ayrı bir yasal standart yok. Etikette onun yerine nelere bakacağını öğren: kalori, protein, eklem iddiaları ve eksik değerler.
- [Ödül mamaları ve mama üstü katkılar alerji diyetini nasıl bozar](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/treats-and-toppers/): Ödül mamaları, çiğneme ürünleri, mama üstü katkılar ve aromalı ekstralar çoğu zaman diyetin kaçındığı proteinleri taşır. Nasıl kontrol edeceğini öğren.
- [Yaş mama mı, kuru mama mı: etiketleri adil karşılaştırmak](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/guides/wet-vs-dry-food-labels/): Yaş mamada protein düşük görünür, çünkü büyük kısmı sudur. Konserve ve kuru mama etiketlerini kuru madde ve kalori bazında adım adım karşılaştır.

## Pawfood guides (Español)

- [¿Alergia o intolerancia alimentaria? Cómo se diferencian en perros y gatos](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/allergy-vs-intolerance/): La alergia alimentaria involucra al sistema inmunitario; la intolerancia no. Los signos se parecen, así que solo una prueba guiada por el veterinario las distingue.
- [«Aves», «grasa animal», «saborizante natural»: términos vagos de las etiquetas](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/ambiguous-terms-poultry/): Qué términos de la etiqueta no nombran al animal, qué pueden contener, por qué importan para las listas de alergias y cómo obtener una respuesta clara del fabricante.
- [Qué significan realmente «subproducto» y «harina» en la etiqueta del alimento para mascotas](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/by-products-and-meals/): Subproductos y harinas son términos definidos, no insultos. Aprende qué incluyen, por qué importa el nombre de la especie y cómo leerlos si hay alergias.
- [Los alérgenos alimentarios más reportados en gatos y dónde se esconden en las etiquetas](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/common-cat-food-allergens/): Res, pescado y pollo encabezan los casos publicados en gatos. Qué significan las cifras, por qué no son un ranking de riesgo y dónde se esconden esas proteínas.
- [Materia seca, explicada: cómo comparar alimento húmedo y seco](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/dry-matter-basis/): Qué es la materia seca, cómo convertir el análisis garantizado paso a paso, cómo estimar los carbohidratos con honestidad y los errores que confunden las comparaciones.
- [Llevar un diario de alimentación de tu mascota: qué anotar y cómo compartirlo con el veterinario](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/food-journal-guide/): Guía práctica para registrar alimentos, premios, síntomas, heces y peso de forma útil para tu veterinario, sin sacar conclusiones propias de los patrones.
- [Alimento sin granos: qué significa la etiqueta y qué no](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/grain-free-explained/): Sin granos significa sin cereales; no es una declaración de bajo carbohidrato ni sobre alergias. Qué reemplaza a los granos y qué dijo la FDA sobre dieta y DCM.
- [Cómo leer la etiqueta del alimento para perros o gatos, paso a paso](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/how-to-read-pet-food-labels/): Un recorrido práctico por cada parte de la etiqueta: reglas del nombre, orden de ingredientes, análisis garantizado, declaración de adecuación, guía de alimentación y letra pequeña.
- [Dietas de proteína hidrolizada: cómo funcionan y qué dice la etiqueta](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/hydrolyzed-protein-diets/): La hidrólisis divide las proteínas en trozos que el sistema inmunitario reconoce con menos probabilidad. Menos probable no es nunca: qué hallaron los estudios y qué preguntar.
- [Conservantes en el alimento para mascotas: tocoferoles mixtos, BHA, BHT y etoxiquina](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/preservatives-explained/): Una mirada neutral a por qué los alimentos llevan conservantes, cómo difieren los antioxidantes naturales y sintéticos, qué dicen las normas y cómo leerlos en la etiqueta.
- [Etiquetas de alimento para cachorros y gatitos: crecimiento, todas las etapas y razas grandes](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/puppy-kitten-food-labels/): Qué revisar en la etiqueta del alimento para cachorros o gatitos, desde la declaración de crecimiento y la frase de razas grandes hasta calorías, calcio y guías de alimentación.
- [Etiquetas de alimento senior: lo que «senior» dice y lo que no](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/senior-pet-food-labels/): No existe un estándar legal propio para el alimento senior. Qué revisar en la etiqueta, desde calorías y proteína hasta las declaraciones articulares y los valores que faltan.
- [Cómo los premios y toppers pueden deshacer una dieta para alergias](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/treats-and-toppers/): Premios, masticables, toppers y extras saborizados suelen llevar justo las proteínas que una dieta evita. Cómo revisarlos y mantener constante una prueba de dieta.
- [Alimento húmedo o seco: cómo comparar las etiquetas de forma justa](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/guides/wet-vs-dry-food-labels/): El alimento húmedo parece bajo en proteína porque es sobre todo agua. Aprende a comparar latas y croquetas en base seca y por calorías, paso a paso.

## Pawfood guides (Português (Brasil))

- [Alergia ou intolerância alimentar? Como se diferenciam em cães e gatos](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/allergy-vs-intolerance/): A alergia alimentar envolve o sistema imunológico; a intolerância não. Os sinais se parecem, então só um teste orientado pelo veterinário as separa.
- [«Aves», «gordura animal», «aroma natural»: termos vagos dos rótulos explicados](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/ambiguous-terms-poultry/): Quais termos do rótulo não indicam o animal, o que cada um pode conter, por que isso importa para listas de alergia e como obter uma resposta clara do fabricante.
- [O que «subproduto» e «farinha» realmente significam no rótulo do alimento para pets](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/by-products-and-meals/): Subprodutos e farinhas são termos definidos, não ofensas. Veja o que incluem, por que o nome da espécie importa e como lê-los quando há alergia.
- [Os alérgenos alimentares mais relatados em gatos e onde se escondem nos rótulos](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/common-cat-food-allergens/): Carne bovina, peixe e frango lideram os casos publicados em gatos. O que os números significam, por que não são um ranking de risco e onde essas proteínas aparecem.
- [Matéria seca explicada: como comparar alimento úmido e ração seca](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/dry-matter-basis/): O que é matéria seca, como converter os níveis de garantia passo a passo, como estimar carboidratos com honestidade e os erros que tornam as comparações enganosas.
- [Diário alimentar do pet: o que registrar e como mostrar ao veterinário](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/food-journal-guide/): Guia prático para registrar alimentos, petiscos, sintomas, fezes e peso de um jeito útil para o veterinário, sem tirar conclusões próprias dos padrões.
- [Alimento sem grãos: o que o rótulo significa e o que não significa](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/grain-free-explained/): Sem grãos quer dizer sem cereais; não é alegação de pouco carboidrato nem sobre alergia. O que substitui os grãos e o que a FDA disse sobre dieta e DCM.
- [Como ler o rótulo do alimento para cães e gatos, passo a passo](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/how-to-read-pet-food-labels/): Um roteiro prático por cada parte do rótulo: regras do nome, ordem dos ingredientes, níveis de garantia, declaração de adequação, recomendação de consumo e letras miúdas.
- [Dietas de proteína hidrolisada: como funcionam e o que o rótulo diz](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/hydrolyzed-protein-diets/): A hidrólise quebra as proteínas em pedaços que o sistema imunológico reconhece com menos chance. Menos chance não é nunca: o que os estudos acharam e o que perguntar.
- [Conservantes no alimento para pets: tocoferóis mistos, BHA, BHT e etoxiquina](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/preservatives-explained/): Um olhar neutro sobre por que os alimentos têm conservantes, como antioxidantes naturais e sintéticos diferem, o que dizem as normas e como lê-los no rótulo.
- [Rótulos de alimento para filhotes: crescimento, todas as fases da vida e porte grande](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/puppy-kitten-food-labels/): O que conferir no rótulo do alimento para filhotes de cão e gato, da declaração de crescimento e da frase sobre porte grande até calorias, cálcio e recomendação de consumo.
- [Rótulos de alimento para pets idosos: o que «sênior» diz e o que não diz](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/senior-pet-food-labels/): Não existe um padrão legal próprio para alimento sênior. O que conferir no rótulo, de calorias e proteína a alegações para articulações e valores ausentes.
- [Como petiscos e toppers podem desfazer uma dieta para alergia](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/treats-and-toppers/): Petiscos, mastigáveis, toppers e extras saborizados muitas vezes trazem justamente as proteínas que a dieta evita. Como conferir e manter um teste de dieta consistente.
- [Alimento úmido ou seco: como comparar os rótulos de forma justa](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/guides/wet-vs-dry-food-labels/): O alimento úmido parece ter pouca proteína porque é principalmente água. Aprenda a comparar latas e ração seca na matéria seca e por calorias, passo a passo.

## Pawfood guides (Deutsch)

- [Futtermittelallergie oder -unverträglichkeit? Der Unterschied bei Hund und Katze](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/allergy-vs-intolerance/): Bei einer Futtermittelallergie ist das Immunsystem beteiligt, bei einer Unverträglichkeit nicht. Die Symptome ähneln sich; Klarheit bringt nur eine tierärztliche Diät.
- [»Geflügel«, »tierisches Fett«, »natürliches Aroma«: vage Begriffe auf Futteretiketten](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/ambiguous-terms-poultry/): Welche Etikettbegriffe keine Tierart nennen, was sie enthalten können, warum das für Allergielisten zählt und wie du vom Hersteller eine klare Antwort bekommst.
- [Was »Nebenerzeugnis« und »Mehl« auf dem Futteretikett wirklich bedeuten](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/by-products-and-meals/): Nebenerzeugnisse und Mehle sind definierte Futtermittelbegriffe, keine Schimpfwörter. Was sie umfassen, warum die Tierart zählt und wie du sie bei Allergien liest.
- [Die am häufigsten berichteten Futtermittelallergene bei Katzen und wo sie sich auf Etiketten verstecken](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/common-cat-food-allergens/): Rind, Fisch und Huhn führen die veröffentlichten Katzenfälle an. Was die Zahlen bedeuten, warum sie keine Risikorangliste sind und wo diese Proteine stecken.
- [Trockensubstanz erklärt: Nass- und Trockenfutter richtig vergleichen](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/dry-matter-basis/): Was Trockensubstanz ist, wie du analytische Bestandteile Schritt für Schritt umrechnest, wie du Kohlenhydrate ehrlich schätzt und welche Fehler Vergleiche verfälschen.
- [Ein Futtertagebuch führen: was du notierst und wie du es mit der Tierarztpraxis teilst](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/food-journal-guide/): Ein praktischer Leitfaden, um Futter, Leckerlis, Symptome, Kot und Gewicht so festzuhalten, dass deine Praxis damit arbeiten kann – ohne selbst zu viel hineinzulesen.
- [Getreidefreies Tierfutter: was das Etikett bedeutet und was nicht](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/grain-free-explained/): Getreidefrei heißt ohne Getreide – keine Low-Carb- und keine Allergieaussage. Was das Getreide ersetzt und was die FDA zu Futter und DCM gesagt hat.
- [Hunde- oder Katzenfutter-Etikett lesen, Schritt für Schritt](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/how-to-read-pet-food-labels/): Ein praktischer Rundgang durch jeden Teil des Etiketts: Benennungsregeln, Reihenfolge der Zutaten, analytische Bestandteile, Futterart, Fütterungsempfehlung und Kleingedrucktes.
- [Hydrolysatdiäten: wie sie funktionieren und was das Etikett verrät](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/hydrolyzed-protein-diets/): Hydrolyse zerlegt Proteine in Stücke, die das Immunsystem seltener erkennt. Seltener heißt nicht nie: was Studien gefunden haben und was du fragen solltest.
- [Konservierungsstoffe in Tierfutter: gemischte Tocopherole, BHA, BHT und Ethoxyquin](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/preservatives-explained/): Ein neutraler Blick darauf, warum Futter Konservierungsstoffe enthält, wie sich natürliche und synthetische Antioxidationsmittel unterscheiden, was die Regeln sagen und wie du sie liest.
- [Etiketten für Welpen- und Kittenfutter: Wachstum, alle Lebensphasen und große Rassen](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/puppy-kitten-food-labels/): Was du auf Welpen- und Kittenfutter prüfen solltest – von der Wachstumsangabe und dem Hinweis für große Rassen bis zu Energie, Calcium und Fütterungsempfehlung.
- [Etiketten für Seniorenfutter: was »Senior« aussagt und was nicht](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/senior-pet-food-labels/): Für Seniorenfutter gibt es keinen eigenen rechtlichen Standard. Worauf du stattdessen achtest – von Energie und Protein bis zu Gelenkversprechen und fehlenden Werten.
- [Wie Leckerlis und Topper eine Allergiediät zunichtemachen können](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/treats-and-toppers/): Leckerlis, Kauartikel, Topper und aromatisierte Extras enthalten oft genau die Proteine, die eine Diät meiden soll. So prüfst du sie und hältst einen Diätversuch konsequent.
- [Nass- oder Trockenfutter: Etiketten fair vergleichen](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/de/guides/wet-vs-dry-food-labels/): Nassfutter wirkt proteinarm, weil es überwiegend Wasser ist. So vergleichst du Dose und Trockenfutter Schritt für Schritt in der Trockensubstanz und nach Energie.

## Pawfood guides (Français)

- [Allergie ou intolérance alimentaire ? Les différences chez le chien et le chat](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/allergy-vs-intolerance/): L'allergie alimentaire fait intervenir le système immunitaire, pas l'intolérance. Les signes se ressemblent : seul un régime encadré par le vétérinaire les distingue.
- [« Volaille », « graisse animale », « arôme naturel » : les termes vagues des étiquettes](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/ambiguous-terms-poultry/): Quels termes d'étiquette ne nomment pas l'animal, ce qu'ils peuvent contenir, pourquoi c'est important en cas d'allergie et comment obtenir une réponse claire du fabricant.
- [Ce que « sous-produit » et « farine » veulent vraiment dire sur une étiquette d'aliment pour animaux](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/by-products-and-meals/): Sous-produits et farines sont des termes définis, pas des insultes. Ce qu'ils recouvrent, pourquoi le nom de l'espèce compte et comment les lire en cas d'allergie.
- [Les allergènes alimentaires les plus rapportés chez le chat et où ils se cachent sur les étiquettes](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/common-cat-food-allergens/): Bœuf, poisson et poulet dominent les cas publiés chez le chat. Ce que valent ces chiffres, pourquoi ce n'est pas un classement de risque et où trouver ces protéines.
- [La matière sèche expliquée : comparer pâtées et croquettes](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/dry-matter-basis/): Ce qu'est la matière sèche, comment convertir les constituants analytiques pas à pas, comment estimer honnêtement les glucides et les erreurs qui faussent les comparaisons.
- [Tenir un journal alimentaire pour son animal : quoi noter et comment le partager avec le vétérinaire](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/food-journal-guide/): Un guide pratique pour consigner aliments, friandises, symptômes, selles et poids de façon utile à votre vétérinaire, sans surinterpréter vous-même les tendances.
- [Aliments sans céréales : ce que dit l'étiquette, et ce qu'elle ne dit pas](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/grain-free-explained/): Sans céréales ne veut dire ni pauvre en glucides ni adapté aux allergies. Ce qui remplace les céréales et ce qu'a dit la FDA sur alimentation et CMD.
- [Lire l'étiquette d'un aliment pour chien ou chat, étape par étape](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/how-to-read-pet-food-labels/): Un parcours pratique de chaque partie de l'étiquette : règles de dénomination, ordre des ingrédients, constituants analytiques, type d'aliment, rationnement et petits caractères.
- [Régimes à protéines hydrolysées : comment ils fonctionnent et ce que dit l'étiquette](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/hydrolyzed-protein-diets/): L'hydrolyse découpe les protéines en fragments que le système immunitaire reconnaît moins souvent. Moins souvent n'est pas jamais : ce qu'ont trouvé les études et quoi demander.
- [Les conservateurs des aliments pour animaux : tocophérols mélangés, BHA, BHT et éthoxyquine](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/preservatives-explained/): Un regard neutre sur la raison d'être des conservateurs, la différence entre antioxydants naturels et de synthèse, ce que dit la réglementation et comment les lire sur l'étiquette.
- [Étiquettes des aliments pour chiots et chatons : croissance, tous stades de vie et grandes races](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/puppy-kitten-food-labels/): Ce qu'il faut vérifier sur l'étiquette d'un aliment pour chiot ou chaton, de la mention de croissance et des grandes races à l'énergie, au calcium et au rationnement.
- [Étiquettes des aliments senior : ce que « senior » dit, et ce qu'il ne dit pas](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/senior-pet-food-labels/): Il n'existe pas de norme légale propre aux aliments senior. Ce qu'il faut vérifier à la place, de l'énergie et des protéines aux allégations articulaires et aux valeurs absentes.
- [Comment friandises et toppers peuvent défaire un régime anti-allergie](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/treats-and-toppers/): Friandises, objets à mâcher, toppers et extras aromatisés contiennent souvent les protéines mêmes que le régime évite. Comment les vérifier et garder un essai alimentaire cohérent.
- [Pâtée ou croquettes : comparer les étiquettes équitablement](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/fr/guides/wet-vs-dry-food-labels/): La pâtée semble pauvre en protéines parce qu'elle est surtout composée d'eau. Apprenez à comparer boîtes et croquettes sur matière sèche et selon l'énergie, pas à pas.

## Pawfood questions and answers (English)

- [Can a blood, hair or saliva test diagnose food allergies in dogs and cats?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/blood-tests-for-pet-food-allergies/): Not reliably. Blood tests for food allergy proved inaccurate in reviews, and hair and saliva tests are unproven. A vet-led elimination diet is the standard.
- [Can a dog with a chicken allergy react to hydrolyzed chicken?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/hydrolyzed-chicken-and-chicken-allergy/): Some can. Hydrolysis makes chicken protein less likely to be recognized, but how far it is broken down matters; studies found reactions to partial hydrolysates.
- [Can I give treats during an elimination diet?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/treats-during-elimination-diet/): Only treats your vet approves, usually made from the trial diet itself. Ordinary treats, chews and flavored medicines can undo the trial.
- [Can pet food contain ingredients that aren't on the label?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/undeclared-ingredients-in-pet-food/): Yes. Studies testing pet foods found undeclared animal or plant ingredients in many products, including some sold for elimination diets.
- [Does 'natural flavor' in pet food contain chicken?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/does-natural-flavor-contain-chicken/): It can. 'Natural flavor' doesn't name its source, and in pet food it is often made from animal tissue such as chicken. Ask the manufacturer.
- [Does a chicken allergy mean my dog can't have eggs?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/chicken-allergy-and-eggs/): Not necessarily. Egg and chicken meat contain different proteins, and evidence on overlap in dogs and cats is limited. Your vet decides whether eggs fit.
- [Does the first ingredient tell me what pet food is mostly made of?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/does-first-ingredient-matter/): Only partly. Ingredients are listed by weight before cooking, so water-heavy fresh meat can come first even if dry ingredients supply more nutrients.
- [How do I calculate the carbohydrates in pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/how-to-calculate-carbs-in-pet-food/): Subtract protein, fat, fiber, moisture and ash from 100. It only works when all five are on the label, and the result is an estimate.
- [How do I know if my cat food has fish in it?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/how-to-tell-if-cat-food-contains-fish/): Read the whole ingredient list, not the front of the pack. Fish hides in oils, digests, broths and vague terms like 'ocean fish' or 'animal digest'.
- [How do I read a cat food label?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/how-to-read-a-cat-food-label/): Check the adequacy statement first, then the ingredient list, the guaranteed analysis and the calories. The product name is the least reliable part.
- [How do I switch my dog to a new food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/how-to-switch-dog-food/): Mix the new food into the old one gradually over several days, increasing the new share step by step, and note how your dog's stool and appetite respond.
- [How long should a food elimination trial last?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/how-long-should-an-elimination-diet-last/): A review found that at least 8 weeks are needed to catch more than 90% of food-allergic dogs and cats. Your vet sets the length for your pet.
- [If my dog is allergic to chicken, can it have turkey or duck?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/chicken-allergy-turkey-duck/): Maybe not. Birds share similar proteins, and lab studies found most chicken-sensitized dogs also recognized turkey and duck. Ask your vet before trying.
- [Is brewers rice bad for dogs and cats?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/is-brewers-rice-bad/): No. Brewers rice is small broken pieces of rice kernels left from milling, a digestible carbohydrate source. It's a by-product, not a quality warning.
- [Is chicken fat okay for a dog with a chicken allergy?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/is-chicken-fat-ok-for-dogs-with-chicken-allergy/): Chicken fat carries far less protein than chicken meat, but not none. Whether a chicken-allergic dog can have it is a decision for your vet.
- [Is grain-free food better for dogs with allergies?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/is-grain-free-better-for-allergies/): Not automatically. Most reported dog food allergies involve animal proteins, not grains. Grain-free only helps if a grain is what your dog reacts to.
- [Is there an app to scan dog food ingredients for allergies?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/app-to-scan-pet-food-ingredients-for-allergies/): Yes. Pawfood is an iPhone app that scans dog and cat food labels and checks each ingredient against your pet's allergens and avoid list.
- [What are BHA, BHT and ethoxyquin in pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/bha-bht-ethoxyquin-in-pet-food/): Synthetic antioxidants that keep fats from going rancid. BHA and BHT are permitted within limits; the EU no longer authorizes ethoxyquin in feed.
- [What are meat by-products in pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-are-meat-by-products/): Meat by-products are clean animal parts other than muscle meat, such as organs, from mammals. The species isn't named, and the US term excludes poultry.
- [What are mixed tocopherols in pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-are-mixed-tocopherols/): Mixed tocopherols are forms of vitamin E used as a natural preservative to slow fats going rancid. They usually come from vegetable oils, often soy.
- [What are the most common cat food allergens?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/most-common-cat-food-allergens/): In published studies, beef, fish and chicken were the most often reported food allergen sources in cats, followed by wheat. Not a risk ranking for your cat.
- [What are the most common dog food allergens?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/most-common-dog-food-allergens/): In published studies, beef, dairy, chicken and wheat were the most often reported food allergen sources in dogs. That isn't a ranking of risk for your dog.
- [What does 'complete and balanced' mean on pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-does-complete-and-balanced-mean/): It means the food is designed to be the only diet for a stated life stage: it has all required nutrients (complete) in the right ratios (balanced).
- [What does 'crude protein' mean on dog food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-does-crude-protein-mean/): Crude protein is total protein estimated from nitrogen content. 'Crude' refers to the lab method, not quality, and it includes plant and animal protein.
- [What does 'for intermittent or supplemental feeding only' mean?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/intermittent-or-supplemental-feeding/): The product isn't nutritionally complete, so it isn't meant as the main diet. Seen on treats, toppers and some wet foods; EU: 'complementary feed'.
- [What does 'limited ingredient' mean on pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-does-limited-ingredient-mean/): It's a marketing term for a recipe with fewer ingredients, often one main protein. It has no set legal definition and isn't a medical claim.
- [What does 'meat and animal derivatives' mean on pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-are-meat-and-animal-derivatives/): It's an EU category name covering meat, organs and by-products of farmed land animals. Unless the label names a species, you can't tell which animals.
- [What does 'poultry meal' mean on dog food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-does-poultry-meal-mean/): Poultry meal is rendered, dried poultry tissue. 'Poultry' doesn't name the bird, so it may be chicken, turkey, duck or a mix.
- [What does the guaranteed analysis on pet food mean?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-is-guaranteed-analysis/): It lists minimum crude protein and fat and maximum fiber and moisture, as fed. They're limits, not exact amounts, and need converting to compare foods.
- [What is a novel protein diet?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-is-a-novel-protein-diet/): A novel protein diet uses a protein your pet has never eaten before, such as rabbit, venison or kangaroo, usually for a vet-led elimination trial.
- [What is animal digest in pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-is-animal-digest/): Animal digest is animal tissue broken down by enzymes or heat into a liquid or powder flavor coating. The species is often not stated.
- [What is dry matter basis and how do I calculate it?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-is-dry-matter-basis/): Dry matter basis means a nutrient value with the water removed. Divide the label value by (100 − moisture) and multiply by 100.
- [What is pea protein and why is it in dog food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/what-is-pea-protein-in-dog-food/): Pea protein is concentrated protein from peas. It raises the food's protein level at lower cost. It counts as plant protein, not meat.
- [What is taurine and why do cats need it?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/why-do-cats-need-taurine/): Taurine is an amino acid cats can't make in sufficient amounts, so it must come from food. Low taurine has been linked to heart and eye disease in cats.
- [What signs are reported in dogs and cats with food allergies?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/signs-of-food-allergy-in-dogs-and-cats/): Mostly itching (ears, paws, belly or face), recurring skin and ear infections, and sometimes vomiting or diarrhea. Your vet works out the reason.
- [What's the difference between 'beef', 'beef dinner', 'with beef' and 'beef flavor'?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/beef-dinner-with-beef-beef-flavor/): US naming rules tie the name to the amount: 'Beef' needs 95% beef (excluding water), 'Beef Dinner' 25%, 'with Beef' 3%, 'Beef Flavor' only a detectable amount.
- [What's the difference between chicken and chicken meal in pet food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/chicken-meal-vs-chicken/): Chicken is fresh or frozen meat that is mostly water. Chicken meal is the same tissue rendered and dried, so it's a concentrated protein source.
- [Where do I find the calories on a pet food label?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/where-are-calories-on-pet-food-label/): Look for the calorie statement, usually 'kcal ME/kg' plus kcal per cup or can, near the guaranteed analysis. EU labels may show kcal per 100 g.
- [Why does wet food show less protein than dry food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/why-wet-food-has-less-protein/): Because wet food is mostly water and label percentages include the water. Remove it (dry matter basis) and wet food often has as much protein or more.
- [Why isn't propylene glycol allowed in cat food?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/questions/propylene-glycol-in-cat-food/): A US FDA regulation bars propylene glycol in or on cat food. In cats it has been associated with red blood cell changes. It's still used in some dog treats.

## Pawfood questions and answers (Türkçe)

- [Alerjisi olan köpekler için tahılsız mama daha mı iyi?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/is-grain-free-better-for-allergies/): Kendiliğinden değil. Köpeklerde bildirilen besin alerjilerinin çoğu hayvansal proteinlerle ilgili. Tahılsız mama yalnızca tepki tahılaysa işe yarar.
- [Besin alerjisi olan köpek ve kedilerde hangi belirtiler bildiriliyor?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/signs-of-food-allergy-in-dogs-and-cats/): Çoğunlukla kaşıntı (kulak, pati, karın ya da yüz), tekrarlayan deri ve kulak enfeksiyonları, bazen kusma ya da ishal. Nedenini veterinerin araştırır.
- [Bezelye proteini nedir ve köpek mamasında neden var?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-is-pea-protein-in-dog-food/): Bezelye proteini, bezelyeden elde edilen konsantre proteindir. Mamanın protein düzeyini daha düşük maliyetle yükseltir. Et değil, bitkisel protein sayılır.
- [Eliminasyon diyeti ne kadar sürmeli?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/how-long-should-an-elimination-diet-last/): Bir derlemeye göre besin alerjisi olan köpek ve kedilerin %90'ından fazlasını yakalamak için en az 8 hafta gerekir. Süreyi hayvanın için veterinerin belirler.
- [Eliminasyon diyeti sırasında ödül maması verebilir miyim?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/treats-during-elimination-diet/): Yalnızca veterinerinin onayladıklarını, genellikle deneme diyetinin kendisinden. Sıradan ödüller ve aromalı ilaçlar denemeyi boşa çıkarabilir.
- [İlk içerik, mamanın çoğunun neyden yapıldığını söyler mi?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/does-first-ingredient-matter/): Kısmen. İçerikler pişirmeden önceki ağırlığa göre sıralanır; sulu taze et, kuru içerikler daha fazla besin sağlasa bile ilk sırada olabilir.
- [Kan, tüy ya da tükürük testi köpek ve kedilerde besin alerjisini teşhis edebilir mi?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/blood-tests-for-pet-food-allergies/): Doğru biçimde değil. Derlemelerde besin alerjisi kan testleri isabetsiz bulundu; tüy ve tükürük testleri kanıtlanmamış. Standart yöntem eliminasyon diyetidir.
- [Kedi maması etiketi nasıl okunur?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/how-to-read-a-cat-food-label/): Önce besinsel yeterlilik beyanına, sonra içindekiler listesine, analitik bileşenlere ve kaloriye bak. Ürün adı etiketin en az kesin kısmıdır.
- [Kedi mamasında balık olup olmadığını nasıl anlarım?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/how-to-tell-if-cat-food-contains-fish/): Paketin önünü değil, içindekiler listesinin tamamını oku. Balık; yağ, hidrolizat, et suyu ve "okyanus balığı" ya da "hayvansal digest" gibi terimlerde saklanır.
- [Kedi mamasında en yaygın alerjenler hangileri?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/most-common-cat-food-allergens/): Çalışmalarda kedilerde en sık bildirilen besin alerjeni kaynakları sığır, balık ve tavuktu; ardından buğday geldi. Kedin için risk sıralaması değildir.
- [Kedi mamasında propilen glikole neden izin verilmiyor?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/propylene-glycol-in-cat-food/): Bir ABD FDA düzenlemesi propilen glikolü kedi mamasında yasaklar; kedilerde kan hücresi değişiklikleriyle ilişkilendirildi. Bazı köpek ödüllerinde kullanılır.
- [Kuru madde bazı nedir ve nasıl hesaplanır?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-is-dry-matter-basis/): Kuru madde bazı, suyu çıkarılmış besin değeridir. Etiketteki değeri (100 − nem) değerine böl ve 100 ile çarp.
- [Köpek maması içeriklerini alerji için tarayan bir uygulama var mı?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/app-to-scan-pet-food-ingredients-for-allergies/): Evet. Pawfood, kedi ve köpek maması etiketlerini tarayıp her içeriği hayvanının alerjenleri ve kaçınma listesiyle karşılaştıran bir iPhone uygulamasıdır.
- [Köpek mamasında "ham protein" ne demek?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-does-crude-protein-mean/): Ham protein, azot içeriğinden tahmin edilen toplam proteindir. "Ham" kaliteyi değil yöntemi anlatır; bitkisel ve hayvansal protein birlikte sayılır.
- [Köpek mamasında "kanatlı unu" ne demek?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-does-poultry-meal-mean/): Kanatlı unu, işlenip kurutulmuş kanatlı dokusudur. "Kanatlı" kuşun türünü söylemez; tavuk, hindi, ördek ya da bunların karışımı olabilir.
- [Köpek mamasında en yaygın alerjenler hangileri?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/most-common-dog-food-allergens/): Çalışmalarda köpeklerde en sık bildirilen besin alerjeni kaynakları sığır, süt ürünleri, tavuk ve buğdaydı. Bu, köpeğin için risk sıralaması değildir.
- [Köpeğimi yeni mamaya nasıl geçiririm?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/how-to-switch-dog-food/): Yeni mamayı birkaç gün içinde eskisine kademeli olarak karıştır, yeni payını adım adım artır ve köpeğinin dışkısını ve iştahını izle.
- [Köpeğimin tavuk alerjisi varsa hindi ya da ördek yiyebilir mi?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/chicken-allergy-turkey-duck/): Belki hayır. Kuşlar benzer proteinler taşır; laboratuvarda tavuğa duyarlı köpeklerin çoğu hindi ve ördeği de tanıdı. Önce veterinerine sor.
- [Kırık pirinç (brewers rice) köpek ve kediler için kötü mü?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/is-brewers-rice-bad/): Hayır. Kırık pirinç, öğütmede pirinç tanelerinden kopan küçük parçalardır; sindirilebilir bir karbonhidrat kaynağı. Yan ürün olması kalite uyarısı değil.
- [Mama etiketinde "tam ve dengeli" ne demek?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-does-complete-and-balanced-mean/): Mamanın belirtilen yaşam evresi için tek diyet olarak tasarlandığı anlamına gelir: gerekli tüm besinler (tam) doğru oranlarda (dengeli) bulunur.
- [Mama etiketinde kaloriyi nerede bulurum?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/where-are-calories-on-pet-food-label/): Analitik bileşenlerin yakınındaki kalori beyanına bak; genellikle "kcal ME/kg" ile ölçek ya da kutu başına kcal. AB etiketleri 100 g başına kcal verebilir.
- [Mama etiketindeki analitik bileşenler (guaranteed analysis) ne anlama gelir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-is-guaranteed-analysis/): En az ham protein ve yağ, en çok selüloz ve nem değerlerini verildiği haliyle listeler. Bunlar kesin miktar değil sınırdır.
- [Mama, etikette yazmayan içerikler barındırabilir mi?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/undeclared-ingredients-in-pet-food/): Evet. Mamaları test eden çalışmalar, eliminasyon diyetleri için satılanlar dahil birçok üründe beyan edilmemiş hayvansal ya da bitkisel içerik buldu.
- [Mamada "et ve hayvansal türevler" ne demek?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-are-meat-and-animal-derivatives/): Çiftlik kara hayvanlarının eti, organları ve yan ürünlerini kapsayan bir AB kategori adıdır. Etiket tür belirtmedikçe hangi hayvanlar olduğunu bilemezsin.
- [Mamada "sınırlı içerik" (limited ingredient) ne demek?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-does-limited-ingredient-mean/): Daha az içerikli, çoğu zaman tek ana proteinli tarifler için bir pazarlama terimi. Belirlenmiş yasal tanımı yoktur, tıbbi bir iddia değildir.
- [Mamada BHA, BHT ve etoksikin nedir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/bha-bht-ethoxyquin-in-pet-food/): Yağların acımasını önleyen sentetik antioksidanlardır. BHA ve BHT sınırlar dahilinde izinlidir; AB etoksikine yem katkısı olarak artık izin vermiyor.
- [Mamada et yan ürünleri nedir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-are-meat-by-products/): Et yan ürünleri, memelilerin kas eti dışındaki organ gibi temiz parçalarıdır. Tür belirtilmez; ABD tanımı kanatlıyı kapsamaz.
- [Mamada hayvansal digest (hidrolizat) nedir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-is-animal-digest/): Hayvansal digest, enzim ya da ısıyla parçalanıp sıvı veya toz lezzet kaplamasına dönüştürülmüş hayvansal dokudur. Tür çoğu zaman belirtilmez.
- [Mamada karışık tokoferoller nedir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-are-mixed-tocopherols/): Karışık tokoferoller, yağların acımasını yavaşlatan doğal koruyucu E vitamini formlarıdır. Genellikle bitkisel yağlardan, sık sık soyadan elde edilir.
- [Mamada tavuk ile tavuk unu arasındaki fark nedir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/chicken-meal-vs-chicken/): Tavuk, büyük kısmı su olan taze ya da dondurulmuş ettir. Tavuk unu aynı dokunun işlenip kurutulmuş halidir; yoğun bir protein kaynağıdır.
- [Mamadaki "doğal aroma" tavuk içerir mi?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/does-natural-flavor-contain-chicken/): İçerebilir. "Doğal aroma" kaynağını söylemez ve mamada çoğu zaman tavuk gibi hayvansal dokudan yapılır. Üreticiye sor.
- [Mamadaki karbonhidrat nasıl hesaplanır?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/how-to-calculate-carbs-in-pet-food/): Protein, yağ, selüloz, nem ve külü 100'den çıkar. Yalnızca beşi de etikette varsa işe yarar ve sonuç bir tahmindir.
- [Sığır', 'sığır menüsü', 'sığır ile' ve 'sığır aromalı' arasındaki fark nedir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/beef-dinner-with-beef-beef-flavor/): ABD adlandırma kuralları adı miktara bağlar: 'Sığır' %95, 'Sığır Menüsü' %25, 'Sığır ile' %3 sığır ister; 'Sığır Aromalı' yalnızca fark edilecek kadar.
- [Taurin nedir ve kediler neden ihtiyaç duyar?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/why-do-cats-need-taurine/): Taurin, kedilerin yeterli miktarda üretemediği bir amino asittir; mamadan alınmalıdır. Düşük taurin kedilerde kalp ve göz hastalıklarıyla ilişkilendirildi.
- [Tavuk alerjisi olan köpek hidrolize tavuğa tepki verebilir mi?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/hydrolyzed-chicken-and-chicken-allergy/): Bazıları verebilir. Hidroliz tavuk proteininin tanınma olasılığını azaltır ama parçalanma derecesi önemlidir; kısmi hidrolizatlara tepki görüldü.
- [Tavuk alerjisi olan köpek tavuk yağı yiyebilir mi?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/is-chicken-fat-ok-for-dogs-with-chicken-allergy/): Tavuk yağı, tavuk etinden çok daha az protein taşır ama sıfır değildir. Tavuk alerjisi olan köpeğin alıp alamayacağına veterinerin karar verir.
- [Tavuk alerjisi, köpeğimin yumurta yiyemeyeceği anlamına mı gelir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/chicken-allergy-and-eggs/): Mutlaka değil. Yumurta ve tavuk eti farklı proteinler içerir; örtüşme kanıtı sınırlı. Yumurtanın uygun olup olmadığına veterinerin karar verir.
- [Yalnızca ara sıra veya ek besleme içindir' ne demek?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/intermittent-or-supplemental-feeding/): Ürün besinsel olarak tam değildir, ana diyet olarak tasarlanmamıştır. Ödüllerde, mama üstü katkılarda ve bazı yaş mamalarda görülür; AB: "tamamlayıcı yem".
- [Yaş mama neden kuru mamadan daha az protein gösteriyor?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/why-wet-food-has-less-protein/): Çünkü yaş mama büyük ölçüde sudur ve etiketteki yüzdeler suyu kapsar. Kuru madde bazında yaş mama çoğu zaman aynı ya da daha fazla protein içerir.
- [Yeni protein kaynaklı diyet nedir?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/tr/questions/what-is-a-novel-protein-diet/): Hayvanının daha önce hiç yemediği bir proteini (tavşan, geyik, kanguru gibi) kullanan diyettir; genellikle veteriner eşliğinde eliminasyon denemesi için.

## Pawfood questions and answers (Español)

- [Si mi perro es alérgico al pollo, ¿puede comer pavo o pato?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/chicken-allergy-turkey-duck/): Quizá no. Las aves tienen proteínas parecidas, y en laboratorio la mayoría de los perros sensibilizados al pollo reconocieron pavo y pato. Consulta antes.
- [¿Cuáles son los alérgenos más comunes en el alimento para gatos?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/most-common-cat-food-allergens/): En estudios publicados, res, pescado y pollo fueron los alérgenos más reportados en gatos, seguidos del trigo. No es un ranking de riesgo para tu gato.
- [¿Cuáles son los alérgenos más comunes en el alimento para perros?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/most-common-dog-food-allergens/): En estudios publicados, res, lácteos, pollo y trigo fueron las fuentes de alérgenos más reportadas en perros. No es un ranking de riesgo para tu perro.
- [¿Cuánto debe durar una dieta de eliminación?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/how-long-should-an-elimination-diet-last/): Una revisión concluyó que hacen falta al menos 8 semanas para detectar a más del 90 % de los perros y gatos con alergia alimentaria. Tu veterinario decide.
- [¿Cómo calculo los carbohidratos del alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/how-to-calculate-carbs-in-pet-food/): Resta proteína, grasa, fibra, humedad y cenizas de 100. Solo funciona cuando los cinco están en la etiqueta, y el resultado es una estimación.
- [¿Cómo cambio a mi perro a un alimento nuevo?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/how-to-switch-dog-food/): Mezcla el alimento nuevo con el anterior poco a poco durante varios días, aumenta la parte nueva por pasos y observa las heces y el apetito de tu perro.
- [¿Cómo leo la etiqueta del alimento para gatos?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/how-to-read-a-cat-food-label/): Revisa primero la declaración de adecuación nutricional, luego ingredientes, análisis garantizado y calorías. El nombre es lo menos preciso.
- [¿Cómo sé si el alimento de mi gato tiene pescado?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/how-to-tell-if-cat-food-contains-fish/): Lee toda la lista de ingredientes, no el frente del empaque. El pescado se esconde en aceites, digestos, caldos y términos vagos como «pescado de océano».
- [¿Dónde encuentro las calorías en la etiqueta del alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/where-are-calories-on-pet-food-label/): Busca la declaración de calorías («kcal EM/kg» y kcal por taza o lata) cerca del análisis garantizado. En la UE puede venir en kcal por 100 g.
- [¿El alimento sin granos es mejor para perros con alergias?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/is-grain-free-better-for-allergies/): No automáticamente. La mayoría de las alergias alimentarias reportadas en perros son a proteínas animales. Sin granos solo ayuda si reacciona a un grano.
- [¿El arroz partido (brewers rice) es malo para perros y gatos?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/is-brewers-rice-bad/): No. El arroz partido son fragmentos de grano que quedan del molido del arroz, un carbohidrato digerible. Ser subproducto no es una alerta de calidad.
- [¿El primer ingrediente dice de qué está hecho sobre todo el alimento?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/does-first-ingredient-matter/): Solo en parte. Los ingredientes se listan por peso antes de cocinar; la carne fresca, llena de agua, puede ir primero aunque los secos aporten más.
- [¿El «saborizante natural» del alimento para mascotas contiene pollo?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/does-natural-flavor-contain-chicken/): Puede. «Saborizante natural» no nombra su fuente, y en alimentos para mascotas suele hacerse de tejido animal como el pollo. Pregunta al fabricante.
- [¿Hay una app para escanear los ingredientes del alimento para perros por alergias?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/app-to-scan-pet-food-ingredients-for-allergies/): Sí. Pawfood es una app para iPhone que escanea etiquetas de alimentos para perros y gatos y compara cada ingrediente con la lista de tu mascota.
- [¿La alergia al pollo significa que mi perro no puede comer huevo?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/chicken-allergy-and-eggs/): No necesariamente. El huevo y la carne de pollo tienen proteínas distintas, y la evidencia sobre solapamiento es limitada. Tu veterinario decide.
- [¿Por qué el alimento húmedo muestra menos proteína que el seco?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/why-wet-food-has-less-protein/): Porque el alimento húmedo es sobre todo agua y los porcentajes de la etiqueta la incluyen. Sin el agua (base seca), suele tener la misma proteína o más.
- [¿Por qué no se permite el propilenglicol en el alimento para gatos?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/propylene-glycol-in-cat-food/): Una norma de la FDA de EE. UU. prohíbe el propilenglicol en alimento para gatos; en gatos se asocia a cambios en glóbulos rojos. Aparece en premios para perros.
- [¿Puede el alimento para mascotas contener ingredientes que no están en la etiqueta?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/undeclared-ingredients-in-pet-food/): Sí. Estudios que analizaron alimentos hallaron ingredientes no declarados en muchos productos, incluidos algunos vendidos para dietas de eliminación.
- [¿Puede un perro con alergia al pollo comer grasa de pollo?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/is-chicken-fat-ok-for-dogs-with-chicken-allergy/): La grasa de pollo lleva mucha menos proteína que la carne de pollo, pero no cero. Si un perro alérgico al pollo puede tenerla lo decide tu veterinario.
- [¿Puede un perro con alergia al pollo reaccionar al pollo hidrolizado?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/hydrolyzed-chicken-and-chicken-allergy/): Algunos sí. La hidrólisis hace menos probable que se reconozca la proteína del pollo, pero el grado importa; hubo reacciones a hidrolizados parciales.
- [¿Puedo dar premios durante una dieta de eliminación?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/treats-during-elimination-diet/): Solo los que apruebe tu veterinario, normalmente hechos de la propia dieta de prueba. Premios comunes y medicamentos saborizados pueden arruinar la prueba.
- [¿Qué diferencia hay entre pollo y harina de pollo en el alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/chicken-meal-vs-chicken/): El pollo es carne fresca o congelada, sobre todo agua. La harina de pollo es el mismo tejido procesado y seco, así que es una fuente de proteína concentrada.
- [¿Qué diferencia hay entre «res», «cena de res», «con res» y «sabor res»?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/beef-dinner-with-beef-beef-flavor/): En EE. UU. el nombre fija la cantidad: «Res» exige 95 % de res (sin agua), «Cena de res» 25 %, «con res» 3 %, «sabor res» solo algo detectable.
- [¿Qué es el digesto animal en el alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-is-animal-digest/): El digesto animal es tejido animal descompuesto con enzimas o calor en un líquido o polvo que da sabor. A menudo no se indica la especie.
- [¿Qué es la materia seca y cómo se calcula?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-is-dry-matter-basis/): En base seca significa un valor nutricional sin el agua. Divide el valor de la etiqueta entre (100 − humedad) y multiplica por 100.
- [¿Qué es la proteína de guisante y por qué está en el alimento para perros?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-is-pea-protein-in-dog-food/): Es proteína concentrada de guisantes (arvejas). Sube el nivel de proteína del alimento a menor costo. Cuenta como proteína vegetal, no como carne.
- [¿Qué es la taurina y por qué la necesitan los gatos?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/why-do-cats-need-taurine/): Un aminoácido que los gatos no producen en cantidad suficiente, así que debe venir del alimento. Su déficit se ha vinculado a problemas de corazón y ojos.
- [¿Qué es una dieta de proteína novedosa?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-is-a-novel-protein-diet/): Usa una proteína que tu mascota nunca ha comido, como conejo, venado o canguro, por lo general en una prueba de eliminación guiada por el veterinario.
- [¿Qué significa el análisis garantizado del alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-is-guaranteed-analysis/): Indica proteína y grasa crudas mínimas y fibra y humedad máximas, tal como se ofrece. Son límites, no cantidades exactas.
- [¿Qué significa «carne y subproductos animales» en el alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-are-meat-and-animal-derivatives/): Un nombre de categoría de la UE para carne, órganos y subproductos de animales de granja. Si la etiqueta no nombra la especie, no sabes cuáles.
- [¿Qué significa «completo y balanceado» en el alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-does-complete-and-balanced-mean/): Que el alimento está diseñado como única dieta para una etapa de vida: tiene todos los nutrientes requeridos (completo) en proporciones correctas (balanceado).
- [¿Qué significa «harina de aves» en el alimento para perros?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-does-poultry-meal-mean/): La harina de aves es tejido de ave procesado y seco. «Aves» no nombra la especie: puede ser pollo, pavo, pato o una mezcla.
- [¿Qué significa «ingredientes limitados» en el alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-does-limited-ingredient-mean/): Un término de marketing para recetas con menos ingredientes, a menudo con una proteína principal. Sin definición legal fija; no es una declaración médica.
- [¿Qué significa «proteína cruda» en el alimento para perros?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-does-crude-protein-mean/): La proteína cruda es la proteína total estimada a partir del nitrógeno. «Cruda» se refiere al método, no a la calidad, e incluye proteína vegetal y animal.
- [¿Qué significa «solo para alimentación intermitente o complementaria»?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/intermittent-or-supplemental-feeding/): El producto no es nutricionalmente completo ni está pensado como dieta principal. Se ve en premios, toppers y algunos húmedos; UE: «alimento complementario».
- [¿Qué signos se reportan en perros y gatos con alergias alimentarias?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/signs-of-food-allergy-in-dogs-and-cats/): Sobre todo picazón (orejas, patas, panza o cara), infecciones de piel y oído recurrentes y a veces vómitos o diarrea. Tu veterinario averigua el motivo.
- [¿Qué son el BHA, el BHT y la etoxiquina en el alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/bha-bht-ethoxyquin-in-pet-food/): Antioxidantes sintéticos que evitan que las grasas se pongan rancias. BHA y BHT están permitidos con límites; la UE ya no autoriza la etoxiquina en piensos.
- [¿Qué son los subproductos cárnicos en el alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-are-meat-by-products/): Son partes limpias de mamíferos distintas de la carne muscular, como órganos. No se nombra la especie, y en EE. UU. el término excluye las aves.
- [¿Qué son los tocoferoles mixtos en el alimento para mascotas?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/what-are-mixed-tocopherols/): Son formas de vitamina E usadas como conservante natural para retrasar el enranciamiento de las grasas. Suelen venir de aceites vegetales, a menudo de soya.
- [¿Una prueba de sangre, pelo o saliva puede diagnosticar alergias alimentarias en perros y gatos?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/es/questions/blood-tests-for-pet-food-allergies/): No de forma fiable. Las pruebas de sangre resultaron imprecisas y las de pelo y saliva no están probadas. Lo estándar es una dieta de eliminación.

## Pawfood questions and answers (Português (Brasil))

- [Alergia a frango significa que meu cão não pode comer ovo?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/chicken-allergy-and-eggs/): Não necessariamente. Ovo e carne de frango têm proteínas diferentes, e as evidências de sobreposição são limitadas. O veterinário decide.
- [Cachorro com alergia a frango pode comer gordura de frango?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/is-chicken-fat-ok-for-dogs-with-chicken-allergy/): A gordura de frango tem bem menos proteína que a carne de frango, mas não zero. Se um cão alérgico a frango pode consumi-la, quem decide é o veterinário.
- [Como calcular os carboidratos do alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/how-to-calculate-carbs-in-pet-food/): Subtraia de 100 proteína, extrato etéreo, matéria fibrosa, umidade e matéria mineral. Só funciona com os cinco no rótulo e é uma estimativa.
- [Como fazer a transição do meu cão para um alimento novo?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/how-to-switch-dog-food/): Misture o alimento novo ao antigo aos poucos ao longo de vários dias, aumente a parte nova em etapas e observe as fezes e o apetite do seu cão.
- [Como ler o rótulo do alimento para gatos?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/how-to-read-a-cat-food-label/): Confira primeiro a declaração de adequação nutricional, depois os ingredientes, os níveis de garantia e as calorias. O nome do produto é a parte menos precisa.
- [Como saber se o alimento do meu gato tem peixe?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/how-to-tell-if-cat-food-contains-fish/): Leia a lista de ingredientes inteira, não a frente da embalagem. O peixe aparece em óleos, digestas, caldos e termos vagos como «peixe oceânico».
- [Existe um app para escanear ingredientes da ração e checar alergias?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/app-to-scan-pet-food-ingredients-for-allergies/): Sim. O Pawfood é um app para iPhone que escaneia rótulos de alimentos para cães e gatos e compara cada ingrediente com a lista do seu pet.
- [O alimento para pets pode ter ingredientes que não estão no rótulo?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/undeclared-ingredients-in-pet-food/): Sim. Estudos que analisaram alimentos acharam ingredientes não declarados em muitos produtos, inclusive em alguns vendidos para dietas de eliminação.
- [O primeiro ingrediente diz do que o alimento é feito principalmente?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/does-first-ingredient-matter/): Só em parte. Os ingredientes são listados pelo peso antes do cozimento, então a carne fresca, cheia de água, pode vir primeiro mesmo que os secos rendam mais.
- [O que significa «carnes e subprodutos de origem animal» no rótulo?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-are-meat-and-animal-derivatives/): Um nome de categoria da UE para carne, órgãos e subprodutos de animais de criação. Se o rótulo não indica a espécie, você não sabe quais são.
- [O que significa «completo e balanceado» no alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-does-complete-and-balanced-mean/): Significa que o alimento foi feito para ser a única dieta numa fase da vida: tem todos os nutrientes exigidos (completo) nas proporções certas (balanceado).
- [O que significa «farinha de aves» na ração para cães?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-does-poultry-meal-mean/): Farinha de aves é tecido de aves processado e seco. «Aves» não indica a espécie: pode ser frango, peru, pato ou uma mistura.
- [O que significa «ingredientes limitados» no alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-does-limited-ingredient-mean/): Um termo de marketing para receitas com menos ingredientes, muitas vezes com uma proteína principal. Não tem definição legal fixa nem é uma alegação médica.
- [O que significa «proteína bruta» na ração para cães?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-does-crude-protein-mean/): Proteína bruta é a proteína total estimada a partir do nitrogênio. «Bruta» se refere ao método, não à qualidade, e inclui proteína vegetal e animal.
- [O que significa «somente para alimentação intermitente ou complementar»?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/intermittent-or-supplemental-feeding/): O produto não é nutricionalmente completo nem foi feito para ser a dieta principal. Aparece em petiscos, toppers e alguns úmidos («alimento complementar»).
- [O que significam os níveis de garantia do alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-is-guaranteed-analysis/): Informam proteína bruta e extrato etéreo mínimos e matéria fibrosa e umidade máximas, na matéria natural. São limites, não quantidades exatas.
- [O que são BHA, BHT e etoxiquina no alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/bha-bht-ethoxyquin-in-pet-food/): Antioxidantes sintéticos que evitam o ranço das gorduras. BHA e BHT são permitidos com limites; a UE não autoriza mais a etoxiquina em rações.
- [O que são subprodutos de carne no alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-are-meat-by-products/): São partes limpas de mamíferos que não são carne muscular, como órgãos. A espécie não é indicada, e nos EUA o termo exclui aves.
- [O que são tocoferóis mistos no alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-are-mixed-tocopherols/): São formas de vitamina E usadas como conservante natural para retardar o ranço das gorduras. Costumam vir de óleos vegetais, muitas vezes de soja.
- [O que é digesta animal no alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-is-animal-digest/): Digesta animal (palatabilizante) é tecido animal quebrado por enzimas ou calor em líquido ou pó que dá sabor. A espécie muitas vezes não é informada.
- [O que é matéria seca e como calcular?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-is-dry-matter-basis/): Na matéria seca significa um valor nutricional sem a água. Divida o valor do rótulo por (100 − umidade) e multiplique por 100.
- [O que é proteína de ervilha e por que ela está na ração para cães?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-is-pea-protein-in-dog-food/): É proteína concentrada de ervilha. Aumenta o nível de proteína do alimento a um custo menor. Conta como proteína vegetal, não como carne.
- [O que é taurina e por que os gatos precisam dela?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/why-do-cats-need-taurine/): Um aminoácido que os gatos não produzem em quantidade suficiente, então precisa vir do alimento. A falta foi ligada a problemas de coração e olhos.
- [O que é uma dieta de proteína inédita?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/what-is-a-novel-protein-diet/): Usa uma proteína que o seu pet nunca comeu, como coelho, cervo ou canguru, geralmente num teste de eliminação orientado pelo veterinário.
- [O «aroma natural» do alimento para pets contém frango?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/does-natural-flavor-contain-chicken/): Pode conter. «Aroma natural» não indica a origem, e em alimentos para pets costuma ser feito de tecido animal como frango. Pergunte ao fabricante.
- [Onde encontro as calorias no rótulo do alimento para pets?](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/pt-br/questions/where-are-calories-on-pet-food-label/): Procure a informação de calorias («kcal EM/kg» e kcal por xícara ou lata) perto dos níveis de garantia. Rótulos da UE podem trazer kcal por 100 g.
